purpose: Select one economically independent no-return mechanism after the government-subsidy source-identity rejection, without reopening a consumed branch, inspecting a new provider row, or searching formulas, directions, ages, fields, weights, or subsets against returns.

frontier_decisions.reason: The adjacent CNInfo guarantee endpoint already returned object-shaped records where the pinned adapter required positional arrays. A lawsuit contract would first need a newly verified no-row transport schema rather than replaying the same currently incompatible positional family.

The previously inspected major-contract route exposed revision-prone current revenue and historically sparse prior-revenue normalization. Amount and revenue fields would also introduce currency, version, and denominator leakage risks.

A dated major-contract disclosure is a direct external-demand and order-confirmation event. Counting distinct disclosed contracts and decaying only by elapsed calendar days avoids amount, revenue, price, valuation, counterparty identity, and financial-statement reuse.

economic_independence.distinct_from_government_subsidy: Government grants are public support transfers; a major contract is a commercial demand/order event. The rejected subsidy source produced no factor and cannot be repaired or substituted.
economic_independence.distinct_from_contract_liability_backlog: Contract liabilities are a quarterly accounting stock of customer prepayments; this candidate is a dated contract disclosure event and never requests balance-sheet values.
economic_independence.distinct_from_related_party_transactions: Related-party transactions measure governance-linked transaction clustering; this candidate measures external commercial order disclosures and requests no relationship field.
economic_independence.distinct_from_performance_forecasts_and_: The event is a company contract disclosure rather than management earnings guidance or analyst interpretation.
economic_independence.distinct_from_prices_and_moneyflow: No OHLCV, return, order-flow, valuation, market-cap, or trading field enters the mechanism.

selected_candidate.source_event_measure: major_contract_disclosure_count = number of globally unique complete contract identities for one supported instrument and announcement_date
selected_candidate.interpretation: More distinct newly disclosed major contracts and greater freshness indicate stronger near-term commercial demand confirmation.
selected_candidate.availability: first local trading session strictly after announcement_date
selected_candidate.multiple_event_dates: Use only the latest already-effective announcement date; a later effective event supersedes an older event.
selected_candidate.future_entry_if_admitted: next local session open after signal-close ranking

prohibited_post_result_actions: change the contract identity after observing a row
drop or fill incomplete contract names or signing dates
switch from count-and-freshness to amount or revenue normalization
change direction, three-calendar-day age, samples, thresholds, or point-in-time timing
retry a consumed acceptance or failed partition
reuse the government-subsidy announcement contract or reinterpret its ambiguous codes
read prices or returns before a separately frozen no-return capacity and uniqueness gate
aggregate, score, select, size, order, or justify Level-2 from acceptance evidence
